about.text: Appellant Annette Ramirez, in her official capacity as the Harris County Tax Assessor-Collector and Voter Registrar (the Registrar) contends that the trial court erred in denying her plea to the jurisdiction because: (1) there has been no violation of the Texas Election Code because the reference to an “address reclassification” in section 15.022(b) of the Election Code is not a reference to a change of address, (2) appellees lack standing, (3) the Registrar has not waived her immunity, and (4) no ultra vires exception applies.

caseName: Annettee Ramirez, in Her Official Capacity as the Harris County Tax Assessor- Collector & Voter Registrar v. Steve Hotze, M.D.
